categories.main_business_segments: China Northern Rare Earth (Group) High-Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the rare earth industry, focusing on rare earth raw materials, rare earth functional materials, and rare earth end-use products. The company produces over 100 types of products across 11 categories, including rare earth salts, oxides, metals, magnetic materials, polishing materials, hydrogen storage materials, catalytic materials, and permanent magnet motors. It also engages in trade and environmental protection businesses related to rare earths.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced rare earth smelting and separation technologies, including green smelting upgrade projects and wet metallurgy processes. It emphasizes innovation in high-performance magnetic materials, solid-state hydrogen storage devices, and rare earth polishing powders. The company has established multiple national and provincial research platforms, including academicians' workstations and joint university-industry laboratories, to drive R&D and technological breakthroughs in rare earth materials and applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream manufacturers in industries such as new energy vehicles, wind power, electronics, precision optics, and environmental protection. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a focus on supplying rare earth raw materials and functional materials to high-tech and strategic emerging industries. Its products are used in sectors like automotive, electronics, energy storage, and industrial catalysis.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production bases located in Baotou, Inner Mongolia, the core of China's rare earth industry. It also has subsidiaries and operations in other Chinese regions such as Gansu, Shandong, Hebei, and Jiangxi provinces. Internationally, it engages in export and import activities but maintains a predominantly domestic operational footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Northern Rare Earth operates across the entire rare earth supply chain, including upstream mining and smelting (processing rare earth ores and concentrates), midstream production of rare earth functional materials, and downstream manufacturing of end-use products like permanent magnet motors. It also engages in rare earth product trading and recycling, positioning itself as an integrated rare earth industry leader.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development driven by innovation, focusing on green, digital, and high-end transformation. R&D efforts target breakthroughs in rare earth smelting, magnetic materials, hydrogen storage, and polishing technologies. It fosters collaboration with academic institutions and industry partners to accelerate technology commercialization and enhance the rare earth industry's value chain. The company also emphasizes ESG integration and sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of rare earth raw materials, functional materials, and end-use products. The company also earns income from trade activities, environmental protection services, and government subsidies. Its revenue streams include product sales, technology licensing, and service fees related to rare earth processing and applications.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As one of the largest and earliest established state-controlled rare earth enterprises in China, the company holds a leading position in the domestic rare earth industry. It benefits from exclusive access to the world's largest rare earth mine (Bayan Obo) via its controlling shareholder Baotou Steel Group. The company competes with other major Chinese rare earth groups and international suppliers, leveraging its full industry chain integration and scale advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 32.97 billion, a slight decrease of 1.58% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.00 billion, down 57.64% from the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 45.38 billion, growing 12.06%. Despite profit decline due to market price fluctuations, the company maintains industry-leading performance and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technological upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its resource advantage with stable access to high-quality rare earth ores, comprehensive industry chain integration from mining to end products, and strong R&D capabilities. It differentiates through green and digital transformation initiatives, high-value functional materials, and specialized end-use products like high-efficiency permanent magnet motors. The company positions itself as a key contributor to national strategic resource security and a leader in sustainable rare earth industry development.
